purpose: negative-control receptor: the ATP site of E. coli DNA gyrase B (4DUH), which is not a target of sulfanilamide; same protocol as the five receptors T1-T5

whole_fragment_box.source: bounding box of every atom of C1_4DUH/receptor.pdbqt plus 5.0 A on each side, edges rounded up to 0.5 A
whole_fragment_box.exhaustiveness_rule: 32 x volume ratio, rounded: the same number of Monte Carlo runs per unit volume as the focused search

protocol.geometry: sulfanilamide species from their B3LYP-D3(BJ)/IEF-PCM geometries; every other ligand from one ETKDG/MMFF94s conformer per seed
protocol.site_definition: pose centroid within 4.0 A of a heavy atom of the crystal inhibitor
protocol.scores: empirical docking scores, kcal/mol by convention; never converted to Ki

target.protein: DNA gyrase B, E. coli, 24 kDa ATPase fragment (chain A)

clorobiocin_reference.method: gemmi.calculate_superposition on the sequence-aligned Ca atoms of chain A (4DUH fixed, 1KZN moved), no trimming

trimmed_fit.note: 3 cycles, pairs beyond 2.0 sigma removed; reported only to show how much of the 0.78 A comes from a few mobile residues

clorobiocin_reference.conclusion: the transferred pose overlaps residues that are ordered in 4DUH and have no counterpart in the 1KZN model, so 4DUH cannot hold clorobiocin in its crystal pose; clorobiocin is not docked, and the control receptor has no cross-docking test
